name: Speed measured against budgets
what: Forking, starting a computer, taking a checkpoint and the memory of an idle computer each have a budget, written before their code as a 99th percentile and a worst case. Each is measured as a distribution over repeated interleaved runs, and so is the cost of keeping the record, on a build and a parallel test suite, in a computer and on a plain machine. Recovery time after a crash is measured too.

suggest.why: Speed is a requirement of Silo, and these measurements are how a slow fork or a computer that keeps its memory is seen; `speed-budgets` and `how-speed-is-measured`, taken, already ask for them.
